wholePhysicalScope: Named 74-vertex hotel outline and individually mapped roof, porch, upper bay and pavilion components in the present complex. Natural Resources Canada bare-earth and first-return fields independently set site grade and roof elevation.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the Château roof, three rear fingers, four oriels and formal canopy.
limitations: The standing hotel’s envelope is surveyed. Small dormers, finials, trim, copper tones, rear finishes and the present entrance furniture are approximate. Roof and chimney control heights are tied to original Canadian lidar.
The separate parking building, Upper Fort Garry Gate, Union Station, interiors, sidewalks and adjoining apartments are outside scope.
